pages.text: Item Pipes haul goods across a pipe network to connected containers and machines — the veins of automation.$(br2)$(bold)Four speeds$(0) (items per tick):$(li)$(4)Item Pipe$(0): 1/t$(li)Intermediate Item Pipe (_advanced): 4/t$(li)Advanced Item Pipe (_elite): 16/t$(li)Ultimate Item Pipe (_ultimate): 64/t$(br2)Pipes only link to $(bold)containers and this mod's machines$(0) (those that support pipe access). By default each end is two-way; the Configurator can switch a section to Push/Pull or sever one side for precise flow.

$(bold)Logistics combo:$(0)$(li)power rides the "$(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l)"$(li)items ride Item Pipes$(li)liquids ride fluid pipes (see "$(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l)")$(br2)The three networks never clash — run them side by side. Classic line: Collector reaps -> Item Pipes move the Essence -> a machine processes it.$(br2)Machines like the "$(l:akaishi:plant_cultivator)Plant Cultivator$(/l)" take pipes too, so farming goes fully automatic.
Pair them with the "$(l:akaishi:collector)Auto Collector$(/l)" for a full automation line; catch up on "$(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l)" for the power side.
